lesson.grammar_point: verb to be with I (I am / I'm not / my name is)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. My name is Daniel Parker. I am an engineer from London. I am not from Brazil, so my Portuguese is very bad. I am here for two weeks, for the metro project. Please speak English with me. Slow English is perfect. Thank you, and see you at the site.

Hi. My name is Carla Nunes. I am an engineer too, and today is my first day in this company. I am from Recife. I am a little nervous, but I am very happy. My English is not perfect, and that is okay. Nice to meet you all.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna meets a new engineer at the office. She says her name in English. She says she is an engineer. She says the name of her company. She says nice to meet you.
